answer: 2.5.8 目标尺寸（最小）（AA 级）要求指针操作的目标至少为 24 × 24 CSS 像素。触控目标同样适用，小于该尺寸时需要保持足够间距。

points.text: 该要求适用于所有指针输入方式，不只是触控，也包括鼠标、触控板、触控笔等。
points.quote: this criterion is scoped to all pointer input modalities – not just touch, but also mouse, trackpad, stylus and others
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
points.source_text:
When creating this success criterion, the Working Group reviewed existing research and guidelines. The majority of this material centers around touchscreen interactions, and suggests relatively large minimum sizes. In contrast, this criterion is scoped to all pointer input modalities – not just touch, but also mouse, trackpad, stylus and others. Requiring large, touch-optimized minimum sizes would not have been appropriate as a threshold for all pointer inputs. For this reason – after reviewing the average target size of various high-traffic sites – the Working Group settled on the smaller measure of 24 by 24 CSS pixels for the "(Minimum)" version of this criterion, while 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced) uses the larger 44 by 44 CSS pixel measure as its threshold size.
The requirement is for targets to be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels in size. There are five exceptions:
